verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim interactive widgets to explore/test the Core API in-browser plus a sandbox for hands-on experimentation, which directly matches the story. However, probes found no OpenAPI/swagger spec exposed, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the widget experience beyond vendor claims. Missing for 10: independent verification of the interactive widget UX, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and evidence of runnable code samples beyond simulation endpoints.
